judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong protocol frame names, interface names, and payload keys (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the exact names specified in the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationCursor`). It also modifies an existing line in `src/types/messages.ts` despite the explicit acceptance criterion that `git diff` of that file must touch no existing line, and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the repository. Furthermore, it misses several explicitly required deliverables: `StoreCannotList`, updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, updates to `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`, startup warnings when `history` is enabled without `resume`, and tests for non-blocking execution during a streaming turn and reconnecting with `?sessionId=`. On the positive side, the core wiring through `createServer`, `messageHandler`, and `validation` (with composite cursor validation and `UNSUPPORTED` error handling) follows the right structural approach.
